mapper.select: SELECT u.id AS uid, u.name, f.nickname AS remark, u.avatar, u.sex, u.personality_signature, f.create_time AS added_at FROM user_friend f INNER JOIN `user` u ON u.id = f.friend_uid WHERE f.uid = #{uid} AND f.friend_uid = #{targetUid} AND f.delete_status = 0 AND f.black_status = 0 LIMIT 1
